name: RunWindmillCLI
description: Runs a wmill command against a Windmill workspace. By default it syncs the repository to the workspace with wmill sync push.
helpMarkDown: Runs `wmill <command> <arguments> --workspace <workspace> --token <token> --base-url <url>`. The wmill CLI must already be on PATH (use the Install Windmill CLI task). See https://www.windmill.dev/docs/advanced/cli/sync
author: Windmill Labs

inputs.name: baseUrl
inputs.label: Windmill base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of your Windmill instance, passed as --base-url.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: API token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Windmill API token, passed as --token. Store it as a secret pipeline variable and reference it here as `$(WMILL_TOKEN)`. Never type the token in the YAML.

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: wmill command
inputs.helpMarkDown: The wmill subcommand, without the leading `wmill`, e.g. `sync push` or `sync pull`.

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.label: Arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Extra arguments. The default is the flag set used by the Windmill git sync pipeline examples. `sync push` needs `--yes` because the pipeline cannot answer prompts.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder that holds wmill.yaml and the synced files (the repository root, after checkout).
